== Work in Progress ==

This page is going to be a mirror of the [[Robert Jordan]] page, which I have done a great deal of work on (usually anonymously cause I don't bother to sign in - Marie Curie has done a lot too). I'm not going to finish it in a day because it's a big job, but I am working on it. I'm sifting all of the WoT-related stuff out of Brandon's blog posts at the moment because those are some of the primary sources I don't have in the Theoryland interview database, but you'll notice as time goes on that he doesn't blog as much, preferring Twitter. I already have his WoT-related Tweets organized, and those will go in later on, along with the book tour signing reports and other interviews. [[User:Terez|Terez]] 20:32, November 21, 2010 (UTC)
